name: Road of Lord
source:
Is it "ruin" or "rebirth" that the encounter brings to history?

A realist mercenary "Vain" from the bottom and an idealist princess "Lady Justice" who was ousted from the country due to false accusations.

Two people who are both born and raised and who have opposite philosophies meet and regain their homeland together.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6584]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
这次相遇给历史带来的是“毁灭”还是“重生”？

出身底层的现实主义雇佣兵“虚荣”和因诬告被驱逐出国的理想主义公主“正义女神”。

两个出生长大、理念截然相反的人相遇并一起夺回家园。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6584]NovelGame[/url]]
